name: Dragon's Return

start.dialog: I sense dragons near. Not the friendly kind. The kind that burn villages. I cannot allow this. Will you stand with me, Dragon Knight to... whatever you are?
start.objective: Accompany Freya to slay the rogue dragon threatening the Uplands

progress.dialog: The dragon's lair is close. I can smell the sulfur. Ready your weapon, friend.
progress.objective: Fight through the dragon's minions to reach its lair

complete.dialog: The dragon is felled. The Uplands are safe. You fought well - with honor and courage. Take this spear. It has slain many dragons. May it serve you as well.

party_comments.kade: A dragon knight. Now that's a title that means something.
party_comments.ashka: She knows the skies. I respect that.
party_comments.vex: Protecting the innocent from beasts. Noble work.

hidden_outcome: If you spare the dragon and drive it away instead, Freya teaches you 'Dragon's Crest' - a technique that grows stronger with each dragon encountered
